The functor <MATH_0001> is cocontinuous, continuous and commutes with fibre products
and equalizers (details omitted; compare with the proof of
Lemma <REF_0001>).
Hence
Sites, Lemmas <REF_0002> and
<REF_0003>
apply and we deduce the formula
for <MATH_0002> and the existence of <MATH_0003>. Moreover,
the functor <MATH_0004> is a right adjoint because given <MATH_0005> and <MATH_0006>
we have <MATH_0007>
as desired. Thus we may apply
Sites, Lemmas <REF_0004> and
<REF_0005> to get the
formula for <MATH_0008>.
